items.sentence: Pause of more than 3 seconds with dizziness or blackouts -> Symptomatic pause: pacing may be considered, depending on the cause (European guidance cites a documented symptomatic pause over 3 seconds in people over 40 with severe recurrent reflex fainting). A pause alone, without symptoms, is judged differently.
items.note: Search summary: 2021 ESC pacing and 2018 ESC syncope guidelines: dual-chamber pacing for age >40 with severe unpredictable recurrent reflex syncope and documented symptomatic asystolic pause >3 s or asymptomatic pause >6 s. 2018 ACC/AHA/HRS: a pause >3 s alone should not diagnose sinus node dysfunction. No NHS or BHF page gave a figure (a Cornwall NHS referral guideline used 2.8 s daytime / 4 s night, a local document, not used).
